title: Training LLMs to Follow Reasoning Instructions with Minimal Edits
title_zh: 用最小编辑训练大语言模型遵循推理指令
abstract_en: Large language models increasingly rely on extended reasoning traces, yet the training signals used to shape this behavior remain coarse. Supervised fine-tuning on full trajectories forces the model to imitate an entire demonstration, overconstraining its output distribution, while trajectory-level reinforcement learning provides only weak credit assignment, rewarding or penalizing whole completions without identifying where they succeed or fail. We propose edit-based training, a general framework for learning from a model's own trajectories via localized textual corrections. Given a sampled completion, an editor identifies the first point of failure under a specified criterion and proposes a minimal replacement span. The model is then supervised only on these edited spans. By design, this concentrates supervision where the model's reasoning first breaks down and aims to preserve its existing reasoning patterns elsewhere. The method applies both offline and online, with the latter continually adapting supervision to the model's evolving failure modes. We instantiate this approach on reasoning instruction following with Qwen3-32B on the ReasonIF benchmark. Compared to full-trajectory imitation and trajectory-level reinforcement learning baselines, edit-based training substantially improves compliance with the reasoning instruction while largely preserving the model's skills on untargeted tasks. These results suggest that localized correction is an effective complement to these approaches for shaping how LLMs reason.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型越来越依赖长推理轨迹，但现有训练信号仍较粗糙：全轨迹监督微调要求模型模仿整条示范，容易过度约束输出；轨迹级强化学习则对整段回答统一奖惩，难以判断具体哪一步出了错。本文提出基于编辑的训练（edit-based training）：从模型自身采样生成结果，由编辑器按指定准则定位首个失败点，给出最小范围的文本替换，并仅在修改后的片段上施加监督。该方法将监督集中在推理首次出错的位置，尽量保留其余推理模式。它既可离线运行，也可在线随模型的失误模式变化而更新监督。在 ReasonIF 基准上对 Qwen3-32B 的实验表明，相较于全轨迹模仿和轨迹级强化学习，该方法显著提升了推理指令遵循能力，同时基本保留了模型在非目标任务上的能力。
key_points_zh: 全轨迹模仿约束过多，整段奖惩又难以定位具体失误；局部编辑让监督直接落在出错处。
对模型自身生成的轨迹定位首个不符合准则的位置，仅用最小替换片段进行监督，无需模仿整条轨迹。
框架支持离线与在线训练；在线训练可随模型失误模式的变化持续调整监督。
在 Qwen3-32B 的 ReasonIF 实验中，该方法比两类基线更能提升推理指令遵循，同时基本保留非目标任务能力。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 用模型自身推理轨迹中的首处失败做局部参数更新，基线比较为指令遵从与原有技能保留之间的取舍提供依据，但未显示改进机制本身也在进化。
